// graph documents: The document format sets deny_unknown_fields and the schema's root is closed,
so a graph cannot carry a $schema key of its own: adding one makes the file
fail salvor graph validate. Editors are pointed at the schema by file pattern
instead, which is what this mapping does. docs/graph-schema.json is generated
from the Rust types and gated against drift, so it always describes the format
the binary in your PATH actually accepts.
